name: Carta
description: Access cap table and investor data directly to your AI workflow. Cap table customers can pull cap table ownership, 409A valuations, and stakeholder details. Model pro-forma rounds and analyze exit scenarios. For investors, access investment metrics, fund performance, accounting data, and company financials instantly. Ask questions, run scenarios, and uncover insights without context switching—your Carta data remains secure and integrated.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Carta to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Carta to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.app.carta.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Carta MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Carta provides these MCP tools: welcome, discover, fetch, list_contexts, set_context, list_accounts, get_current_user, cap_table_chart, and cap_table_healthcheck.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Carta?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Carta in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Carta requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Carta is developed by Carta. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
